newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swede invents tie-on condom to avoid fumbling.
newsitem.headline: Swede invents tie-on condom to avoid fumbling.

text.p: Swedish entrepreneur Hans Backman is looking for financial backing for a new product -- a tie-on condom designed to avoid embarrassing fumbling.
Backman, 47, says the loose-fitting condom secured with the aid of two elasticated bands is better than a traditional condom which could become punctured by a finger-nail.
"Things can go wrong when you are fumbling in the dark," Backman told the tabloid daily Aftonbladet on Tuesday.
Backman said he had already invested more than 120,000 dollars on patents and development but now needed up to 900,000 dollars to produce the condoms.
